english.title: Allow vehicle to leave pig protection zone without being inspected and licensed to leave by inspector
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) allowed a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE..), that had been used to transport pigs in a protection zone declared following confirmation of disease in domestic pigs, namely **(..SPECIFY ZONE..), to leave the zone following cleansing and disinfection without being inspected and licensed to leave by an inspector
english.legislation: Contrary to paragraph 1(3) of Schedule 4 to and regulation 39(1)(t) and (2) of the Diseases of Swine Regulations 2014.
